image_description: A close-up portrait of a Great White Pelican (Pelecanus onocrotalus) facing left. The bird features white plumage with a pinkish hue, a long S-curved neck, and a massive pink bill with a visible gular pouch. A second pelican is visible in the soft-focus background to the right. The setting appears to be a rocky shoreline with water.
